result.instructions: Tools for MoeGo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which appointments do we have tomorrow, and which pets are coming?"; "Show the customers that we added in the last 30 days."; "Which orders from this week are not paid yet?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MoeGo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run moego_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run moego_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run moego_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. moego_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: moego_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List the companies the API key can access. Call first: it returns the obfuscated company ids that every other tool needs. API: POST /v1/companies:list.

tools.name: moego_get_company
tools.title: Get a company
tools.description: Get one company (name, country, time zone). API: GET /v1/companies/{id}.

tools.name: moego_list_businesses
tools.title: List businesses (locations)
tools.description: List the business locations of a company, with address and contact data. API: POST /v1/businesses:list.

tools.name: moego_get_business
tools.title: Get a business (location)
tools.description: Get one business location by obfuscated id. API: GET /v1/businesses/{id}.

tools.name: moego_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List pet-parent customers of a company. Filter by phone number or by last update time. API: POST /v1/customers:list.

phone_number.description: Only the customer with this main phone number.

updated_after.description: RFC 3339 time: only customers updated at or after it.

updated_before.description: RFC 3339 time: only customers updated before it.

tools.name: moego_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer with contact data, addresses, notes, tags and preferences. API: GET /v1/customers/{id}.

tools.name: moego_list_customer_notes
tools.title: List customer notes
tools.description: List the staff notes on a customer. API: POST /v1/customers/{id}/notes:list.

tools.name: moego_list_customer_tags
tools.title: List customer tags
tools.description: List the tags on a customer. API: POST /v1/customers/{id}/tags:list.

tools.name: moego_list_pets
tools.title: List pets
tools.description: List pets of a company. Filter by owner ids or last update time. API: POST /v1/pets:list.

tools.name: moego_list_customer_pets
tools.title: List pets of a customer
tools.description: List the pets of one customer. API: POST /v1/customers/{customerId}/pets:list.

tools.name: moego_get_pet
tools.title: Get a pet
tools.description: Get one pet (breed, weight, vaccinations, vet, behavior, codes, notes). API: GET /v1/customers/{customerId}/pets/{id}.

tools.name: moego_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments of a company. Filter by start time range, status, customers, pets. Times are RFC 3339. API: POST /v1/appointments:list.

business_ids.description: Only these obfuscated business ids (from moego_list_businesses).

start_after.description: RFC 3339: appointment starts at or after this time.

start_before.description: RFC 3339: appointment starts before this time.

updated_after.description: RFC 3339: last updated at or after this time.

tools.name: moego_get_appointment
tools.title: Get an appointment
tools.description: Get one appointment with its pets, services, staff, times and amounts. API: GET /v1/appointments/{id}.

business_id.description: Obfuscated business id of the appointment.

tools.name: moego_list_appointment_notes
tools.title: List appointment notes
tools.description: List the notes of one appointment. API: POST /v1/appointments/notes:list.

tools.name: moego_list_blocks
tools.title: List time blocks
tools.description: List blocked (not bookable) time slots such as staff days off. API: POST /v1/blocks:list.

business_ids.description: Only these obfuscated business ids (from moego_list_businesses).

tools.name: moego_get_booking_availability
tools.title: Get online booking availability
tools.description: Get the dates and times that clients can book online for a location. Read only: it books nothing. API: POST /v1/online_booking/availability.

tools.name: moego_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders (invoices) with status and amounts. Filter by status or last update time. API: POST /v1/orders:list.

business_ids.description: Only these obfuscated business ids (from moego_list_businesses).

tools.name: moego_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order with its totals, tips, tax and discounts. API: GET /v1/orders/{id}.

tools.name: moego_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments of a company, optionally for given orders. API: POST /v1/payments:list.

tools.name: moego_get_payment
tools.title: Get a payment
tools.description: Get one payment with method, status, fees and refunds. API: GET /v1/payment/{id}.

tools.name: moego_list_discounts
tools.title: List discount codes
tools.description: List the discount codes of a company. API: POST /v1/discounts:list.

tools.name: moego_list_retail_products
tools.title: List retail products
tools.description: List retail products for sale. API: POST /v1/retail/products:list.

business_ids.description: Only these obfuscated business ids (from moego_list_businesses).

tools.name: moego_list_memberships
tools.title: List membership plans
tools.description: List membership plans. Filter by name. API: POST /v1/memberships:list.

tools.name: moego_list_membership_subscriptions
tools.title: List membership subscriptions
tools.description: List customer membership subscriptions. API: POST /v1/memberships/subscriptions:list.

tools.name: moego_list_packages
tools.title: List customer packages
tools.description: List prepaid service packages and their usage, optionally for given customers. API: POST /v1/packages:list.

tools.name: moego_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List sales leads (potential customers). API: POST /v1/leads:list.

tools.name: moego_get_lead
tools.title: Get a lead
tools.description: Get one lead. API: GET /v1/leads/{id}.

tools.name: moego_list_agreements
tools.title: List agreements
tools.description: List agreement templates (contracts and waivers) of a company. API: POST /v1/agreements:list.

business_ids.description: Only these obfuscated business ids (from moego_list_businesses).

tools.name: moego_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: List the business reports that exist for a company (ids for moego_fetch_report_data). API: POST /v1/reports:list.

tools.name: moego_fetch_report_data
tools.title: Fetch report data
tools.description: Fetch the table data of one report for a time period. API: POST /v1/reports/data:fetch.

business_ids.description: Only these obfuscated business ids (from moego_list_businesses).

tools.name: moego_append_customer_note
tools.title: Add a customer note
tools.description: WRITE: add one staff note to a customer profile. It adds a new note on every call and does not replace or delete notes. Do not retry after a timeout: check moego_list_customer_notes first. API: POST /v1/customers/{id}/notes.
